name: newsroom-agents
description: Claude Code plugins for investigative journalism: investigation orchestration, charts and maps, OSINT, Portuguese public records, fact-checking, corporate/financial research, and document processing.

plugins.name: newsroom-core
plugins.description: Investigation orchestrator, evidence log, timeline builder, data analysis and pre-publication review.

plugins.name: newsroom-graphics
plugins.description: Graphics desk: D3 interactive charts, choropleth and locator maps with Portuguese geodata (CAOP), graphics review, validated palette.

plugins.name: osint-toolkit
plugins.description: OSINT research, image/video geolocation, social media investigation, web evidence archiving.

plugins.name: pt-public-records
plugins.description: Portuguese public records: Diario da Republica, courts, Portal BASE, transparency registers, LADA requests.

plugins.name: fact-check
plugins.description: Claim verification and source triangulation with a shared verification standard.

plugins.name: financial-corporate
plugins.description: Corporate ownership mapping and offshore/leaks/sanctions research.

plugins.name: document-tools
plugins.description: PDF-to-Markdown pipeline with a hook that blocks reading PDFs directly.
